sloka: यः कृत्यवान्सुवर्णेन सुवर्णं लभते स्म सः ।वित्तार्थी लभते वित्तं रत्नार्थी रत्नमेव च ।। ७.९२.१५ ॥
transliteration: yaḥ kṛtyavānsuvarṇena suvarṇaṁ labhate sma saḥ ।vittārthī labhate vittaṁ ratnārthī ratnameva ca ।। 7.92.15 ॥

translations.english: Whoever had a need for gold obtained gold, those desiring wealth obtained wealth, and those desiring jewels indeed obtained jewels.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! जिस समय तुमने इस शूद्र को मारा था, वह बालक तो उसी समय जी उठा था
